criteria.description: Leads with outcomes / what changed / what's at stake rather than a list of activities the team did.
Surfaces the blocker prominently and makes the decision-needed explicit (the delay-vs-cut-scope call), with a clear ask — not buried.
States an overall status that honestly reflects the slipping search launch (at-risk/off-track), rather than a rosy 'all good'.
Is structured and scannable (clear sections, lead-with-the-point) for a busy exec audience.
Includes what's next / what to expect, not only a rear-view summary.
